settings.help: ODM identifier used during the Key manifest authentication process. This setting is only configurable, and must be non-0, when OEM Public Key Hash is set (See PlatformIntegrity/OemPublicKeyHash).
settings.label: Key Manifest ID
settings.name: KM_ID

settings.help: This option configures the which boot guard policy profile will be used. Note: all profiles with the exception of profile 0 - fvme support txt being enabled.
settings.label: Boot Guard Profile
settings.name: BTG_PROFILE

settings.help: This setting determines BSP behavior when it receives an INIT signal. When set to 'Enabled' BSP will behave normally if it receives an INIT (Disabled BSP Initialization (DBI) bit = 0). When set to 'Disabled' BSP will shutdown if it receives an INIT ('DBI' bit = 1).
settings.label: BSP Initialization
settings.name: BSP_INIT_DIS

settings.help: This setting determines if CPU debug modes will be displayed. When set to 'Yes' CPU debugging is enabled.
settings.label: CPU Debugging
settings.name: CPU_DEBUG_DIS

settings.help: Enable MRP support for critical layout components
settings.label: MRP Enabled
settings.name: MRP_EN

settings.help: When this setting is enabled, JTAG access will be disabled, when manufacture is completed. An Intel DPT token can be used to re-enable JTAG.
settings.label: Disable JTAG
settings.name: DFX_DISABLE_CLTAP

settings.help: When this setting is enabled, BSCAN access will be disabled, when manufacture is completed. An Intel DPT token can be used to re-enable BSCAN.
settings.label: Disable Boundary Scan
settings.name: DFX_DISABLE_BSCAN

settings.help: Configure usage of Intel FPF for Intel(R) Firmware Version Control (Intel(R) FVC) mechanism for Secure Boot Key Manifest component.
settings.label: Key Manifest FVC State
settings.name: KM_SVN_EN

settings.help: Configure usage of Intel FPF for Intel(R) Firmware Version Control (Intel(R) FVC) mechanism for OEM Key Manifest component.
settings.label: OEM Key Manifest FVC State
settings.name: OEM_KM_SVN_EN

settings.help: Configure usage of Intel FPF for Intel(R) Firmware Version Control (Intel(R) FVC) mechanism for GSC FW Manifest component.
settings.label: GSC HW SVN Enabled
settings.name: GSC_FW_SVN_EN

settings.help: Configure usage of Intel FPF mechanism for ESE ROM component.
settings.label: Intel(R) Silicon Security Engine ROM FVC State
settings.name: ESE_ROM_SVN_EN

settings.help: Configure usage of Intel FPF for Intel(R) Firmware Version Control (Intel(R) FVC) mechanism for CSE Bootstrap component.
settings.label: CSE Bootstrap FVC State
settings.name: CSE_BOOTSTRAP_SVN_EN

settings.help: Configure usage of Intel FPF for Intel(R) Firmware Version Control (Intel(R) FVC) mechanism for CSE component.
settings.label: CSE FVC State
settings.name: CSE_FW_SVN_EN

settings.help: This setting will permanently disable Manageability hardware through platform FPFs. At End-of-Manufacturing (EOM), enable/disable policy value is committed to FPF and can never be changed. Permanently disabling Manageability HW via this setting requires 'Manageability Application Supported' is set to permanently disabled and 'Intel(R) ME Network Services Supported' is set to disabled. Note: When 'Manageability Application Hardware Status' is Enabled but 'Manageability Application Supported' is set to permanently disabled and 'Intel(R) ME Network Services Supported' is set to disabled, Manageability HW is disabled by a soft strap.
settings.label: Manageability Application HW State
settings.name: AMT_HW_EN

settings.help: FPF that indicates if the device is designed such that it may lose PRTC power more than 10 times throughout the normal lifecycle of the product and hence has no persistent time or AR protection. At EOM, this value is burned to an FPF, and can never be changed.
settings.label: Persistent PRTC Backup Power
settings.name: NCC

settings.help: This setting will permanently disable Intel(R) PTT through platform FPFs. Caution: Using this option will permanently disable Intel(R) PTT on the platform hardware.
settings.label: Intel(R) PTT Supported [FPF]
settings.name: FTPM_EN

settings.help: This setting allows OEMs to configure their PCIe Vendor ID Unique ID into the platform FPFs.
settings.label: UPID OEM ID [FPF]
settings.name: OEM_ID

settings.help: This setting allows OEMs to configure a Unique Platform ID into the base FPFs. Note: The OEM Platform ID FPF and Platform ID for the DnX Image should match.
settings.label: DnX OEM Platform ID
settings.name: PLAT_ID

settings.help: DnX permanent enable/disable FPF
settings.label: DnX State
settings.name: DNX

settings.help: Enabling the OEM key revocation mechanism requires 'OEM Public Key Hash' and 'Second OEM key hash' to be configured.
settings.label: OEM Key Revocation Supported
settings.name: OEM_RH_EN

settings.help: This setting determines if RPMC is enabled. Note: The SPI parts being used need to support RPMC In order to use this feature.
settings.label: RPMC FW Supported
settings.name: RPMC_EN

settings.help: This setting determines if RPMC is enabled over eSPI OOB to be handled by EC (EC might provide RPMC capabilities or offload it to another SPI flash device).
settings.label: RPMC Over EC Supported
settings.name: RPMC_OVER_EC_EN

settings.help: This setting determines if Rebinding of RPMC enabled SPI parts is enabled.
settings.label: RPMC Rebinding Supported
settings.name: RPMC_RB

settings.help: This setting determines is enabled for the platform.
settings.label: TXT Supported
settings.name: TXT_EN
